newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton market closed for Moslem festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton market closed for Moslem festival.

text.p: The Bombay cotton market was closed on Friday for the Moslem festival of Eid al-Adha. Trading resumes on Saturday.
On Thursday Punjab cotton remained steady in a narrow price band while Gujarat varieties bounced back from reduced levels.

In spot, Gujarat Kalyan rose 300/400 rupees to 13,200/13,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg). Punjab saw-ginned was steady at 1,510/1,640 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and Bengal-deshi was quiet at 880/925 rupees per maund.
